title: The Armorer
description: The Armorer led the Mandalorian covert on Nevarro. When the covert revealed themselves to protect Din Djarin and Grogu, the Armorer remained behind. During the fight between Djarin's allies and Moff Gideon, the Armorer provided him with a jet pack before severely beating a group of Stormtroopers. The Armorer made a new covert on the Glavis Ringworld.
